name: Salvinorin A
summary: Salvinorin A is a psychedelic substance belonging to the Salvinorin, Terpenoid chemical class.

pharmacology.text: Research has shown that salvinorin A is a potent κ-opioid receptor (KOR) agonist (Ki = 2.4 nM, EC50 = 1.8 nM). It has a high affinity for the receptor, indicated by the low dissociation constant of 1.0 nanomolar (nM). It shows atypical properties as an agonist of the KOR relative to other KOR agonists.

body.says: Salvinorin B; Salvinorin A glucuronide; Others

uses.text: Salvinorin A is currently being researched in relation to its properties as an anti-addiction drug, and several analogs with improved pharmacokinetic profiles have been shown to have anti-addictive effects as well.

summaryZh: 沙維諾林A（英語：Salvinorin A）是一種有機化合物，分子式C23H28O8，屬於幾種從墨西哥鼠尾草中提取的沙維諾林化合物之一，可用作精神解離劑與致幻劑。

sideEffects.en: Effects come on fast and can be overwhelming, with loss of touch with surroundings, falls and injuries, confusion, fear and sometimes lasting distress. Driving or being near hazards while affected is dangerous.
sideEffects.zh: 效果來得很快，可能強烈到難以承受，包括與周遭環境失去聯繫、跌倒受傷、意識混亂、恐懼，有時還有持續的不適感。在藥效期間開車或靠近危險物是危險的。
sideEffects.zhHans: 效果来得很快，可能强烈到难以承受，包括与周遭环境失去联系、跌倒受伤、意识混乱、恐惧，有时还有持续的不适感。在药效期间开车或靠近危险物是危险的。

fact.en: Salvinorin A was identified as the active compound of Salvia divinorum in the 1980s, and in 2002 it was found to act on the kappa-opioid receptor. It is the only known strong psychoactive natural product with no nitrogen atom.
fact.zh: 沙維諾林 A 在 1980 年代被確認為墨西哥鼠尾草的活性成分，2002 年又發現它作用於 κ 鴉片受體。它是已知唯一不含氮原子的強效天然精神作用物質。
fact.zhHans: 沙维诺林 A 在 1980 年代被确认为墨西哥鼠尾草的活性成分，2002 年又发现它作用于 κ 鸦片受体。它是已知唯一不含氮原子的强效天然精神作用物质。
